genomes.name: Mid-Month Dip and Red Friday
genomes.thesis: A 1.3% five-day dip between the 13th and the 25th above the 200-day, or a red Friday; out the next session or at the turn of the month.
genomes.rationale: round 3, Claude: the calendar leader's two real legs, cleaned

entry_rules.when: day_of_month >= 13 and day_of_month <= 25 and ret5 < -0.013 and close > sma200
